community.title: Community
community.intro: Things you can do for the people around you. Everything here stays on this device.
community.pledgesHint: Choose a promise you want to keep.
community.classGoal: Together, everyone in {name} is collecting {target} stars by helping people around the town.
community.sampleNote: For now this counts the stars of every player on this device. When your class joins Saksham, everyone's stars will count together.
community.askHint: Have a question about your rights? Write it here. It is saved only on this device, and only you can see it. Saksham doesn't send it to anyone: show it to a teacher or a grown-up you trust, and they can help you find the answer.
community.askError: Please write your question first (up to {max} letters).
community.askSaved: Saved. Only you can see it.
community.askDanger: If you or someone else is in danger right now, don't wait for an answer.
community.placesHint: Grown-ups in these places can help a child.
me.title: Me
credits.title: Credits
class.title: My class
class.hint: If your teacher gave you a class code, type it here. You will join as {name}. You can keep playing without a class.
class.inClass: You're in {name}. Your teacher can see your first name in their class.
class.leaveNote: Your game on this device keeps everything. You just won't be in your teacher's class any more.
class.problemCode: That code didn't work. Check it with your teacher: it may have a typo, or it may be switched off.
class.problemOffline: You're not connected to the internet right now. Keep playing, and try again later.
class.problemGeneral: Something went wrong. Please try again in a little while.
dashboard.failed: The latest progress couldn't be loaded. Check your connection; it will try again.
dashboard.empty: No students yet. Students join from Me › My class in the game, with this class's code.
dashboard.wrongCount: ({wrong} of {answered} got it wrong the first time)
teacher.title: For teachers
teacher.offline: The class server isn't set up on this copy of Saksham, so classes aren't available here. The game works without it.
teacher.intro: Make a class, then give your students its join code. Children only ever give their first name.
teacher.accountMode: Sign in or create an account
teacher.checkEmail: Check your email and open the link to confirm your account. Then sign in here.
teacher.errorCredentials: That email and password don't match. Please try again.
teacher.errorNotConfirmed: Please confirm your email first: open the link we sent you.
teacher.errorExists: There is already an account with this email. Sign in instead.
teacher.errorWeak: Please choose a longer password (at least 8 characters).
teacher.errorRateLimit: Too many emails were sent just now. Please wait a while and try again.
teacher.errorGeneral: Something went wrong. Please check your connection and try again.
teacher.errorSave: That change wasn't saved. Please check your connection and try again.
teacher.noClasses: No classes yet. Create one above.
teacher.codeOn: Students can join with this code.
teacher.codeOff: This code is turned off: nobody new can join.
teacher.deleteYes: Yes, delete {name} and its students' class data
reviewer.title: Content review
reviewer.intro: Each item below is a rights card, a building's games, or the Help Centre, exactly as children will read them. Send new or changed items for review, read each one, then publish it or reject it with a note.
reviewer.notReviewer: {email} isn't a reviewer. Ask the project owner to make this account a reviewer.
reviewer.send: Send new and changed items for review
reviewer.nothingNew: Nothing is new or changed since it was last sent.
reviewer.changed: Changed since it was sent: send it again
nav.label: Main
settings.title: Settings
onboarding.nameHint: Only your first name. It stays on this device.
onboarding.nameError: Please use only letters, up to 20. For example: Asha or Ravi.

results.title: Well done, {name}!

results.starBest: 90% or more, with the best choice every time
results.cardSaved: Your card is saved in your Book.
results.unlocked: A new place is open in the town!
results.gentle: If anything like this is happening to you or someone you know, you can talk to someone who helps.
badge.kindHelperAbout: You helped people in two places.
badge.quizWhizAbout: Every answer right on the first try.

town.mitthuAllDone: You've done every place so far. Amazing work!
town.guideHint: Mitthu: Let's go to {name}. Follow me!
town.nowOpen: {place} is open now. Let's go there next!
book.intro: Every rights card you collect is kept here. Tap one to read it again.
book.writing: This story is still being written.
me.badgesHint: Badges are for things you did. Keep exploring to earn more.
credits.intro: Saksham was made for this project. Here is where everything in it comes from.
credits.art: Every picture, character and sound in Saksham is drawn or made in code for this project. Nothing is copied from other games.
credits.lawTitle: Where each rights card comes from
credits.lawHint: Each card quotes the law exactly as written. These are the sources.
credits.hindi: The Hindi in Saksham was written with the help of a computer and has not yet been checked by a fluent speaker. Some words may be wrong or sound odd.
